prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: pixel-art eye animation atlas for Daggerfall Unity NPC record 85
Primary request: Create one clean 2-by-2 sprite atlas using the supplied eye reference grid as the exact layout guide and the original portrait as identity and palette reference. Each equal cell shows the same complete original upper 64x35 portrait half, in row-major order: open, half closed, closed, repeated open. The full atlas aspect ratio must be exactly 64:35 (1.828571), matching the reference grid; no margins, gutters, borders, labels, text, or extra frames. Keep each cell's framing and crop identical.
Input images: Image 1 is the native original 64x64 portrait, for identity, geometry, and subdued colors. Image 2 is the 2x2 enlarged original upper-half reference grid; follow its cell order, spacing, gaze, and pixel scale.
Scene/backdrop: The unchanged original face and hair in each upper-half cell.
Subject: Same front-facing brown-eyed woman, same brow anatomy, eye spacing and iris positions in all phases. Emotion is afraid: worried inner brows drawn slightly up and together, with tense but restrained lids and alert attention. Show apprehension through brows and eyelids only, not enlarged eyeballs.
Style/medium: Crisp low-resolution game pixel art, nearest-neighbor pixel clusters, same soft muted contrast and original 1990s portrait palette.
Composition/framing: Four equal cells, two columns by two rows. Each cell contains the complete original upper half from hairline through lower edge of source crop. Exact atlas aspect ratio 64:35. No added crop or scale differences between cells.
Color palette: Stay close to source muted warm tan skin, subdued brown irises, soft brown brows and original shadow colors. Preserve the same iris hue and highlights. Avoid orange skin patches, red tones, near-black brows, or bright white flashes.
Constraints: Keep face, nose, face width, chin, hair, neck boundary, background, eye spacing, original small iris width, iris height, gaze, and iris centers unchanged. Iris geometry and color stay identical and stationary in all four cells; do not enlarge, round, stretch, shrink, shift, or let an iris cross the lower eyelid. Change only brow expression and lid coverage inside the eye area. Brows and stationary orbital creases stay in the same coordinates through all blink phases. Closed phase has no visible iris or sclera. Half-closed phase covers the same original eyeball vertically while keeping the iris stationary. Repeated open cell must match first open cell exactly in appearance.
Avoid: Giant round or anime eyes, larger pupils, upward iris shift, gaze jump, stretched eyeballs, exposed new white pixels, eyelid through lower lid, thick black eyebrows, orange complexion, lipstick red, white teeth flashes, new facial features, changed skin lighting, altered framing, text, watermark, grid labels.
